title: Chia Seed Pudding
description: Overnight-soaked chia seeds in almond milk, creating a thick pudding rich in fiber and omega-3s.
steps: Combine the chia seeds, almond milk and vanilla in a jar.
Refrigerate at least 4 hours, or overnight.
Stir through yogurt and maple syrup, then top with berries.

source.label: Adapted from Minimalist Baker chia pudding

notes: Chia seeds absorb liquid and expand in the stomach, giving genuinely long-lasting fullness for a small snack.
